ops.body: v0.45.0 changes the premise: the binary now signs under the stable dotted identifier com.yasyf.cc-pool, so the app-group consent is ONE-TIME (re-asked only on signing-identity change, e.g. unsigned local builds — the formula now Dev-ID-signs --HEAD builds on maintainer machines too). Surfacing fpConsentPending loudly is still worthwhile for the first-ever consent, but it is no longer a per-upgrade event; doctor/status copy landed in v0.45.0 already names the approve+restart remediation.
